items.item: The share sheet delivers items to intake
items.evidence: expo-sharing plugin in mobile/app.config.ts; mobile/src/app/+native-intent.ts; acquire.ts fromShare. prebuild-verified: target rs.theorem.app.ShareExtension with group.rs.theorem.app. built for the iOS Simulator: EAS build dccbb349 (simulator profile, Debug) and EAS build 321364ec (preview-simulator, Release, Hermes bundle embedded) produced PlugIns/expo-sharing-extension.appex (rs.theorem.app.ShareExtension, com.apple.share-services, principal class expo_sharing_extension.ShareIntoViewController, activation: text, 1 web URL, 10 images, 10 files, MinimumOSVersion 16.4). built for the device SDK, unsigned: EAS build ed461e9f (device-compile: iphoneos 27.1 SDK, Debug, signing off) compiled and linked it with no diagnostics from our sources. Neither build is signed, and EAS simulator builds carry no entitlements, so the App Group is not yet provisioned or signed for a device. expo-sharing's receiving is experimental and its extension opens the app, which Apple does not document for share extensions. built locally 2026-11-12 with Xcode 27.2 (27B52), iPhoneSimulator 27.2 SDK (bun run ios after expo prebuild --clean and pod install): Build Succeeded, 0 errors, 5 warnings, with the app, ExpoWidgetsTarget.appex and expo-sharing-extension.appex. simulator-observed (iOS 26.5, signed out): in Photos, Share lists Theorem; choosing it runs expo-sharing-extension and opens the app (back link "Photos"); signed out, the app shows sign-in and the shared photo is not kept (owner decision 12). Intake holding the item is not observed: that needs a signed-in session. Not observed on a device.

items.item: Theo's actions in Shortcuts, Siri, Spotlight and on the Action button
items.evidence: mobile/app-intents/TheoIntents.swift, AppShortcuts.swift, AppIntentsSetup.swift (expo-app-intents 0.5.16, alpha); mobile/src/features/invocation. test-verified: routing (invocation.test.ts, 5 tests). built for the iOS Simulator 27.1 SDK: EAS build dccbb349 (simulator profile, Debug) and EAS build 321364ec (preview-simulator, Release, Hermes bundle embedded) compiled the three Swift files into the app target with no diagnostics; ExtractAppIntentsMetadata wrote Theorem.app/Metadata.appintents and the build trained the three phrase sets (capture, share, continue). The binary links AppIntents.framework. built for the device SDK, unsigned: EAS build ed461e9f (device-compile: iphoneos 27.1 SDK, Debug, signing off) compiled and linked it with no diagnostics from our sources. built locally 2026-11-12 with Xcode 27.2 (27B52), iPhoneSimulator 27.2 SDK (bun run ios after expo prebuild --clean and pod install): Build Succeeded, 0 errors, 5 warnings, with the app, ExpoWidgetsTarget.appex and expo-sharing-extension.appex. simulator-observed: Shortcuts lists the three actions (Capture for a conversation, Share into a conversation, Continue the conversation). Running Capture for a conversation on iOS 26.5 failed: "Unable to run App Shortcut"; linkd logged "Unable to get teamId from rs.theorem.app" then "Couldn't find AppShortcutsProvider". Metadata.appintents names the provider (7Theorem12AppShortcutsV) and the type is in Theorem.debug.dylib; the simulator signature is ad-hoc with no team identifier. On iOS 27.2 linkd registered the shortcuts (LNAppShortcutsChangedNotification); running one there was not attempted. Whether a team-signed device build runs them, and whether each opens the right screen, is not observed.

items.item: One interface for every way of capturing the screen
items.evidence: mobile/modules/theo-capture/ios/CaptureRoute.swift. built for the iOS Simulator (EAS build dccbb349 (simulator profile, Debug), EAS build 321364ec (preview-simulator, Release, Hermes bundle embedded)) under Swift 6. There canImport(ScreenCaptureKit) is false, so describe() reports route none with the reason that the simulator has no ScreenCaptureKit; that string is in the built binary. built for the device SDK, unsigned (EAS build ed461e9f (device-compile: iphoneos 27.1 SDK, Debug, signing off)).

items.item: The ScreenCaptureKit route on iOS 27
items.evidence: mobile/modules/theo-capture/ios/ScreenCaptureKitRoute.swift, TheoCaptureModule.swift, TheoCapture.podspec. prebuild-verified: UIBackgroundModes screen-capture and audio, NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription; autolinking resolves pod TheoCapture. built for the device SDK, unsigned: EAS build ed461e9f (device-compile: iphoneos 27.1 SDK, Debug, signing off) compiled and linked it with no diagnostics from our sources, after four fixes the compiler forced: the module is @unchecked Sendable for Expo 58's Sendable AsyncFunction closures; ScreenCaptureKit is weak-linked for iphoneos only because the iPhoneSimulator 27.1 SDK has no ScreenCaptureKit; SCStreamConfiguration.minimumFrameInterval is unavailable on iOS, so the route throttles to one frame a second itself; the route's isolation is stated for Swift 6 region checking. On the simulator the route compiles out and describe() says so. Not signed, not run, not observed: the seven device checks wait for a signed build on an iPhone with iOS 27.

items.item: A native build of the app with its two extensions
items.evidence: built on EAS 2026-11-12 with Xcode 27.1 (27A9275): dccbb349 (simulator, Debug dev client, arm64+x86_64), 321364ec (preview-simulator, Release, Hermes bundle embedded) and ed461e9f (device-compile, iphoneos 27.1, signing off), each with the app, ExpoWidgetsTarget.appex and expo-sharing-extension.appex. Not done: a signed development build (needs the owner's device registered and the App Group provisioned). mobile/eas.json device-compile and .eas/build/device-compile.yml rerun the unsigned device compile. expo-doctor's one failing check (packages one patch behind, held by the three-day gate) was not rerun. built locally 2026-11-12 with Xcode 27.2 (27B52), iPhoneSimulator 27.2 SDK (bun run ios after expo prebuild --clean and pod install): Build Succeeded, 0 errors, 5 warnings, with the app, ExpoWidgetsTarget.appex and expo-sharing-extension.appex. Xcode 27.2 needed three fixes Xcode 27.1 did not: mobile/plugins/own-group-file-references.js (one Info.plist reference in two groups, expo/expo#52987), the TheoremSession podspec anchoring package checkouts on OBJROOT instead of MODULE_CACHE_DIR (default derived data), and mobile/src/app/index.tsx (the root Stack had no anchor, so a plain launch opened Unmatched Route). Ran in the iOS Simulator: iPhone 17 Pro on iOS 26.5 and on iOS 27.2 (same .app). The unsigned device compile was not rerun on Xcode 27.2.

items.item: Observed on an iPhone
items.evidence: Nothing observed on a device. Of the plan's 24 checks: 1 and 2 passed by build, on EAS (Xcode 27.1) and locally (Xcode 27.2), not by observation; 3 (signing, App Group provisioning) not attempted. 10 partly simulator-observed: Theorem is in the Photos share sheet and opens the app, but signed out the item is not kept and intake is not reached. 11 partly simulator-observed: Shortcuts lists the three actions; running one failed in the simulator (no team identifier); the Action button was not tried. 4 to 9 and 12 to 17 not attempted: each needs a signed-in session, and 12 to 15 a device for the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen. 18 to 24 not attempted: they need an iPhone on iOS 27 (the simulator SDK has no ScreenCaptureKit). Signing in needs a dev bearer token from the owner or a registered OAuth client.
